rules.B: 0.25–0.5u; 2-leg Core Parlay; each leg Market >=55%, prefer 65–82%; My Fair >= Market +3pp; combo My Fair >=40%; different matches, low correlation; exclude unresolved rotation/motivation/lineup shocks
rules.A-: Qualified positive-edge but lower-confidence than A; <=0.5u; no forced entry

football_intelligence.model: market de-vig prior + calibrated football residual + uncertainty-aware EV; Poisson is supporting goal distribution only

fair_model.note: Initial priors, not calibrated production coefficients. Cup rotation is evaluated relative to opponent quality: negative lineup penalties may be softened by a pre-match depth-mismatch score, while tier_gap and squad_depth are explicit bounded terms. Backtest and recalibrate; do not fit coefficients from one result.

core_parlay.note: B-class Core Parlay: each leg must have Market Probability >=55% and My Fair >= Market +3pp; 65%-82% Market Probability is preferred, not mandatory. Two-leg combo My Fair must be >=40%. Use different matches and prefer low correlation. Exclude any leg with unresolved rotation uncertainty, motivation uncertainty, or lineup shock. High market probability alone is not alpha.

on_demand_live_research.trigger: user explicitly requests analysis of a specific in-progress match
on_demand_live_research.rules: Fresh timestamped score/minute, red cards, XI, odds, conditional fair and event status; absent current synchronized feeds report WATCH/PASS with no made-up EV. Never edit frozen prematch forecast or simulate live entry without actual contemporaneous quote; preserve historical ex ante records.

grade_policy.policy: Prioritize ex-ante A/A- qualified value signals as core paper research basket, without retroactively upgrading calls. Grade cannot override positive net EV, verified fresh quote, model uncertainty, lineup/risk gates or exposure caps. A- max 0.5u and A max 0.75u. Report B/C, PASS and all fixtures as separate diagnostic cohorts. Compare A vs A- vs B by hit rate, hypothetical stake ROI, CLV, Brier and uncertainty with sample size and confidence intervals. No grade is a guarantee.

residual_model.market_prior: timestamped de-vig consensus from full mutually exclusive market
residual_model.feature_inputs: frozen PIT z-scores; absent factor => no adjustment; unfitted weights => no trade
residual_model.activation: requires chronological out-of-sample residual-vs-market ROI, calibration and CLV improvement; 500-match raw Poisson backtest ROI -20.39%

v04.activation_guard: Historical standalone football 1X2 closing-odds proxy -20.39% ROI (383 bets); no automatic A/A- recommendation until improved genuine out-of-time verification.

post_match_review.policy: Do not count conversational PASS predictions as paper fills or coefficient training. Use genuinely frozen ex ante PIT snapshots, verified market definition and results; evaluate all fixtures including PASS.
